up: Return a table of activity records for IC50 assays against human Glycogen synthase kinase‑3β (standard units = nM). For each matching activity, include the compound's ChEMBL ID, canonical SMILES, the compound key from compound_records, the PubMed ID or DOI of the source document, the assay description, the target ChEMBL ID, and the target preferred name.
sql:
SELECT DISTINCT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  cs.canonical_smiles,
  cr.compound_key,
  COALESCE(CAST(d.pubmed_id AS TEXT), d.doi) AS pubmed_id_or_doi,
  ass.description AS assay_description,
  td.chembl_id AS target_chembl_id,
  td.pref_name AS target_name
FROM activities a
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
JOIN target_dictionary td ON ass.tid = td.tid
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN compound_records cr ON a.record_id = cr.record_id
LEFT JOIN docs d ON a.doc_id = d.doc_id
WHERE td.pref_name = 'Glycogen synthase kinase-3 beta'
  AND td.organism = 'Homo sapiens'
  AND a.standard_type = 'IC50'
  AND a.standard_units = 'nM';
